clues: This settlement sits in the far south of Namibia. It lies close to the border with South Africa.
This dry place sits at the edge of a coastal desert. Rain falls very rarely, yet winter still brings frost.
Traders, hunters and missionaries lived here first. Its hot springs were first put to use in the early 1900s.
Here is the tale to retell at home. Not long ago, people found uranium in the land all around this settlement.
Its hot springs are now being made into a sight for visitors. That warm water is the mark of this place.
